description: Switch the shell's active project, mirroring `iyke project switch <path>`. Accepts a root path (separators, trailing slashes, and casing are normalized) or a bare project id (e.g. "default"). Resolves against the project list and fails with the candidate list when nothing matches. Same side effects as iyke_project_set_active.

path.description: Project root path (or a bare project id).

name: iyke_project_switch
